# OMEAX Joint Stock Company

> OMEAX Joint Stock Company (Business Registration: 0110535209, established November 8, 2023) is a Vietnam-based distributor of mechanical and electrical equipment for building systems, specializing in HVAC, plumbing, and fire protection applications. OMEAX distributes Grundfos pumps and Ocean Cooling Tower products and supplies complete MEP solutions to developers, contractors, and designers across Vietnam from offices in Hanoi (Thanh Xuan district) and Ho Chi Minh City (Tan Binh district).

OMEAX is the Vietnamese member of the global Omeax group, which includes entities in France (Omeax SARL, headquarters), China (OMEAX Shanghai Flow Control Co., LTD), Hong Kong (Omeax Company Limited), and the Philippines (Omeax Entreprises).

## Product Lines

- [Grundfos Pumps](https://www.omeax.vn/products): Booster pumps, transfer pumps, HVAC circulation pumps, drainage pumps, fire fighting pumps (UL/FM certified).
- [Grundfos Valves](https://www.omeax.vn/products): General industrial valves, hydraulic control valves, special valves.
- [Ocean Cooling Tower — Valves](https://www.omeax.vn/products): PICV (Pressure Independent Control Valves), motorized ball valves.
- [Ocean Cooling Tower — Heat Pumps](https://www.omeax.vn/products): Air-to-water heat pumps, all-in-one heat pumps.
- [Ocean Cooling Tower — Measurement](https://www.omeax.vn/products): Water meters, ultrasonic BTU meters, plate heat exchangers.
- [Partner Systems](https://www.omeax.vn/products): Complete HVAC systems, hot water systems.

## Served Market

Vietnam nationwide. Client sectors: Grade-A office towers, luxury residential (Vingroup, Sun Group, CapitaLand, BRG Group), hotels (Marriott, Sheraton, Hyatt), hospitals (VinMec), data centers (CMC), industrial (VinFast).
